export_controls.text:
America, not China must set the rules of the road on AI. @SenFettermanPA is right and Bernie Sanders is incredibly wrong. @HouseForeignGOP has been at the forefront of developing common sense legislation to help ensure the United States wins this race and prioritizes American interests over those of the Chinese Communist Party. 

A key part of this is my legislation, called the Chip Security Act, which is designed to stop China from acquiring the advanced processing chips required to enhance their civilian and military AI capabilities.

deepseek.reason: He promotes his Chip Security Act to stop China from acquiring advanced processing chips for AI.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly endorses restricting China's access to advanced chips through his legislation.

export_controls.text: This is why my bill, the Deterring American AI Model Theft Act, is a must pass to stop these model extraction attacks.

deepseek.reason: The speaker says his Deterring American AI Model Theft Act is a must-pass bill to stop model extraction attacks.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly urges passage of a bill targeting theft of US AI models, which is export-control enforcement.

export_controls.text: Model extraction attacks are the latest frontier of Chinese economic coercion and theft of US intellectual property. American AI models are demonstrating transformative cyber capabilities, and it is critical we prevent China from stealing these technological advancements. I am proud to champion the Deterring American AI Model Theft Act to advance the third pillar of the Trump Administration’s AI Action Plan. We must be more proactive in stopping the circumvention of US export controls by foreign adversaries.

deepseek.reason: The speaker champions a bill to stop circumvention of US export controls by foreign adversaries.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly supports proactive enforcement against export-control circumvention.

export_controls.text: This is the second chip smuggling bust in the past week which only proves that China will stop at nothing to get access to America’s advanced technology. This is exactly why we must pass my bill, the Chip Security Act, to ensure that China can never again use the black market to get the AI chips it needs to stay competitive with our great American innovators.

deepseek.reason: The speaker calls for passing his Chip Security Act to stop China from using the black market to obtain AI chips.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly urges passage of a bill aimed at blocking black-market chip access.

export_controls.text: We are here today to discuss the AI Arms Race against the Chinese Communist Party and our law enforcement efforts to protect America's crown jewel technologies. [...] China's AI chips cannot compete with ours, so Beijing is resorting to theft instead. This chip smuggling story is just one example of how China's AI ambitions are living off of stolen American technology.

deepseek.reason: The speaker describes law enforcement efforts and a chip smuggling story without explicitly endorsing a specific export-control restriction or enforcement policy.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement is about chip smuggling enforcement but does not clearly call for or endorse a policy.

astra.reason: The speaker frames enforcement against Chinese chip smuggling as protecting America's valuable technologies from theft.
astra.confidence_reason: The protective framing supports enforcement, although the statement does not request a specific enforcement measure.

export_controls.text: The Remote Access Security Act fixes this problem by giving the administration—all administrations—the authority and flexibility to restrict China's cloud-based access to our most advanced AI technologies.
export_controls.context: House floor speech in support of the Remote Access Security Act (H.R. 2683), which would close cloud-service loopholes in U.S. AI export controls.

deepseek.reason: He supports the Remote Access Security Act to restrict China's cloud-based access to advanced AI.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly endorses a bill closing cloud-service loopholes in AI export controls.

export_controls.text: Last month, President Donald Trump created a generational opportunity by bolstering America’s lead in artificial intelligence (AI) when he refused to negotiate selling China the crown jewels of U.S. technology: cutting-edge AI chips like Nvidia’s Blackwell. [...] America is still leading the AI arms race. However, the decisions America makes today will decide if we keep that edge or permanently lose it to the Chinese Communist Party.

deepseek.reason: He praises Trump for refusing to sell cutting-edge AI chips to China.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly endorses restricting advanced AI chip sales to China.

export_controls.text: I am glad to see the Trump Administration crack down on Chinese AI chip smugglers. In order to maintain our innovative advantage and protect our national security, Congress must pass the Chip Security Act, my bipartisan legislation to combat illegal chip diversion.

deepseek.reason: He calls on Congress to pass the Chip Security Act to combat illegal chip diversion.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly endorses a bill targeting illegal chip diversion.

export_controls.text:
It is great to see the Trump Administration release America’s AI Action Plan that lays out why we need to pass my legislation, H.R. 3447. The Chip Security Act leverages new and existing location verification features for advanced AI chips to ensure chips are not shipped to bad actors and countries of concern.

Read more here: https://t.co/MG0K0Bq1c2

deepseek.reason: The speaker endorses the Chip Security Act's location-verification features to keep advanced AI chips from countries of concern.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly supports chip location verification as an export-control measure.

export_controls.text: Are you seeing a large number of diversions of U.S. AI chips? [...] could location tracking potentially assist BIS in preventing diversions of these chips to China?
export_controls.context: House Foreign Affairs Subcommittee hearing on the BIS FY 2026 budget, focusing on export controls and AI chip diversion risks.

deepseek.reason: The speaker asks whether chip location tracking could help BIS prevent diversions to China but does not state a position on export controls.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The question addresses export-control enforcement but leaves the speaker's direction ambiguous.

export_controls.text: Export controls play a crucial role in ensuring that U.S. and allied technologies are not used to fuel the CCP's pursuit of global dominance.
export_controls.context: Opening statement by the subcommittee chair at a House Foreign Affairs Subcommittee hearing on the BIS FY2026 budget, focused on export controls and the US–China AI competition.

deepseek.reason: The speaker says export controls play a crucial role in keeping U.S. and allied technologies from fueling CCP global dominance.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly praises export controls as crucial for a security goal.

export_controls.text: OK. Well, U.S. export controls on China's AI capabilities are only effective if China is unable to produce an alternative technology stack at scale. [...] Is that the formal position of the U.S. government? And is that their assessment?
export_controls.context: Congressional hearing on the Bureau of Industry and Security FY2026 budget, examining export controls and AI competition with China.

deepseek.reason: The speaker asks about the effectiveness and official position on export controls without endorsing or opposing them.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement is a question about export-control effectiveness, not a clear stance.

export_controls.text: Under Secretary Kessler, I'm interested in hearing more about how you think that we should categorize AI when contemplating our export control strategy. Is it a general purpose technology like electricity or steam engines? Or is it more of a weapon? And is it closer to an F-35 or a Boeing 737? And how should these analogies shape our export control strategy?
export_controls.context: House hearing on the BIS FY2026 budget, examining export controls and AI strategy.

deepseek.reason: The speaker asks how AI should be categorized for export-control strategy without taking a position.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement is an inquiry about categorization and strategy, with no explicit support or opposition.

export_controls.text: There are serious concerns that SMIC is violating U.S. export controls in its production of advanced AI shifts for Huawei. Will you commit to utilizing the increased enforcement budget to thoroughly investigating SMIC and finally determine SMIC's compliance with U.S. export controls?
export_controls.context: House committee hearing on the BIS FY2026 budget, focused on export controls and AI competition with China.

deepseek.reason: The speaker asks BIS to use increased enforcement funding to investigate SMIC's compliance with U.S. export controls.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The speaker explicitly seeks enforcement action against alleged export-control violations.

export_controls.text:
Today, I introduced the Chip Security Act, bipartisan legislation to protect American innovation and prevent advanced AI computer chips from falling into the wrong hands. 

Thank you to @RepBillFoster, @RepMoolenaar, @CongressmanRaja, @RepRickCrawford, @RepJoshG, @RepLaHood, and @RepTedLieu for your collaboration and leadership on this critical issue!

Learn more about the Chip Security Act  ⬇️

deepseek.reason: The speaker says he introduced the Chip Security Act to prevent advanced AI chips from falling into the wrong hands.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly identifies the speaker as introducing legislation restricting advanced AI chip access.

export_controls.text: American innovation and AI computing technology has the potential to change everything from how we complete daily tasks to unlocking the next era of scientific breakthroughs [...] In order for the United States to maintain our technological advantage, we must employ safeguards to help ensure these advanced AI chips are not being shipped to bad actors who would use them for nefarious purposes. The Chips Security Act is a bipartisan solution that strengthens our ability to protect American interests as well as our technological advances.

deepseek.reason: The speaker says the Chips Security Act employs safeguards to stop advanced AI chips being shipped to bad actors.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement directly endorses safeguards against shipping advanced AI chips to bad actors.

export_controls.text: What assurance do we have that your Department, from your Department, the United States is working to combat or deter the use of AI technologies against ourselves or our allies from places like China?
export_controls.context: House Foreign Affairs Committee hearing on modernizing U.S. arms exports and the AUKUS partnership.

deepseek.reason: The question concerns deterring foreign use of AI technologies, not export controls on advanced AI chips.
deepseek.confidence_reason: No mention of export controls or chip access restrictions.
